timeout_overhead_basis: Initial smoke; prior thesis cold-start overhead below 60 seconds
limitations: One synthetic appointment and economic regime; not a representative empirical population
E1 capacity is deliberately loose; not an E1 scarcity benchmark
All orders released at cycle start; not a late-release stress benchmark
Most fixed assignments are already nearest-satellite assignments
A low-cost single-batch optimum is an admissible finding; do not tune prices to guarantee M8 wins

M5 fixes dispatch slots but does not require positive recovery in each slot; M6-M8 require productive delivery and recovery. Without harmonizing this rule, M5 is not automatically a strict subset control for M6.
